info.name: AWS IoT SiteWise Access Policies Tags#resourceArn API
info.description: Welcome to the IoT SiteWise API Reference. IoT SiteWise is an Amazon Web Services service that connects Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) devices to the power of the Amazon Web Services Cloud. For more information, see the IoT SiteWise User Guide. For information about IoT SiteWise quotas, see Quotas in the IoT SiteWise User Guide. Contact Support: Name: Mike Ralphson Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com
